title: TUR applied remedies
description: What tur-runtime keeps beside an application once the person applies an autopilot result (tur-runtime app autopilot --apply): the remedies, the environment variables every launch of the application then gets, whether /dev/ntsync is left out of its sandbox, and the backup taken before anything was changed, which undoes the change (tur-runtime app autopilot --revert). The file is prefixes/<app-id>/remedies.json, written by tur-runtime only and never visible to the application.

backup.description: The name of the backup taken first, as prefix backup names it.

environment.description: Added to every launch of the application; a variable the person sets on the command line wins. The launch rules apply: no variable the runtime manager sets itself, nothing starting with LD_.

case_folding_before.description: Whether drive C: was case-insensitive before; a revert restores it as it was.
